article_content: Coronation Street actress Barbara Knox, aged 80, has been charged with driving under the influence in Cheshire. The actress, who plays Rita Tanner in the ITV soap, was arrested last month after visiting her daughter, Maxine Ashcroft, at Knutsford Police Station. Ashcroft had also been arrested for drink-driving. A Cheshire Police spokesman confirmed that Knox is due to appear before Macclesfield Magistrates' Court on 24 April. Earlier this week, Ashcroft was fined and banned from driving for two years after pleading guilty to drink-driving. Her lawyer described the incident as a 'terrible error of judgement' and a 'classic case of alcohol anaesthetising good sense'. No changes were necessary.

article_content: A suicide attack at a cafe in Somalia's town of Beledweyne has resulted in significant casualties, including the deaths of at least 13 people and injuries to several dozen others. Prime Minister Abdi Farah Shirdon has condemned the attack and offered his condolences to the families of the victims. Al-Shabaab, a militant Islamist group, has claimed responsibility for the attack on their website.
